per_candidate.id: s2:Dark Matter Density Profiles of Selected Spiral Galaxies
s2:Cosmic thermodynamics of interacting scenario of EBEC dark matter and holographi

rationale: The paper 2410.05948 directly investigates the diversity in dwarf galaxy rotation curves, which is relevant to understanding the dark matter distribution in these galaxies compared to CDM predictions. It provides new evidence on the role of baryonic physics in explaining observed rotation curves, contributing to the question but not fully resolving it.
